title: Blessed Miguel Agustín Pro, Priest and Martyr
subtitle: Optional Memorial (USA) · Rev 14:1-3, 4b-5; Lk 21:1-4
text: On November 23, 1927, Fr. Miguel Pro, a Mexican Jesuit who had ministered in secret during the persecution, was executed by firing squad in Mexico City. He forgave his executioners, stretched out his arms in the form of a cross, and said, "¡Viva Cristo Rey!" Pray today for priests who serve where faith costs something.
imageAlt: Black-and-white 1927 photograph of Fr. Miguel Pro standing before the firing squad wall with his arms stretched out in the form of a cross
